items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: So Lester's sound when he came with the band, it left a big void, a big hole in the sound of the band

ctx.x: Tell me about that before we go on. Because I remember I interviewed Lester and Lester told me that he had a terrible time because people kept saying they wanted to hear him play like Coleman Hawkins.

Well, I suppose that was only natural. But actually, the sound of Fletcher Henderson's band suffered, and with all bands that are popular, the band itself has a certain sound which has nothing to do with the calibre of musicians, let's put it that way, who are in the band, or who takes whose place or whatever. So Lester's sound when he came with the band, it left a big void, a big hole in the sound of the band which was no, you know, not casting any reflection on Lester, because he played, and there were some…
